thread:
incidents-bot: P1 - Dedicated pool anomaly affecting Acme Corp (tenant: acme-corp, VPC: vpc-01). Large, sudden token usage spike + p99 latency increase. Paging @mike (oncall) and tagging billing. Incident page: https://redwood.incidents/1742004321 :rotating_light:

mike: ack, I'm on it. grabbing logs and current routing.

jess: ping — noticed a correlated surge of 5xx retries from the proxy to the runtime around 09:12 UTC. could be a retry-loop.

billing-bot: Automated meter snapshot for tenant=acme-corp (window 09:00-09:15 UTC):
```
tenant: acme-corp
09:05:12 tokens: 12,432
09:06:01 tokens: 98,721
09:07:03 tokens: 240,193
09:08:47 tokens: 1,203,411
09:10:00 tokens: 1,209,501
```

oliver (cs): customer reached out — billing spike alert hit them, they see their dashboard showing abnormal charges. they're requesting immediate isolation and a billing freeze if possible.

mike: current actions: 1) temporarily rate-limit acme-corp at edge (50rps) 2) route acme traffic to fallback shared pool (read-only routing) 3) stop async retry path on API gateway. Applying now.

jess: logs from runtime show repeated prefix-expansion calls from the same request IDs — looks like KV cache invalidation caused re-eval and double-counting of tokens per attempt. adding sample trace:
```
trace_id=01H8... req=abcd1234 attempts=6 tokens_accounted=[240,240,240,240,240,240]
runtime: prefix_expand -> cache_miss -> recompute -> account_tokens
```

billing-bot: Real-time meter tail for acme-corp (post-mitigation):
```
09:15:05 tokens: 12,000
09:16:10 tokens: 13,100
09:17:22 tokens: 13,250
```

mike: mitigation seems to reduce incoming token rate by ~98%. latency p99 dropping. Proposal: 1) keep rate-limit and shared pool routing for 2 hours, 2) pause meter ingestion for acme-corp for the 09:06-09:12 window pending reconciliation, 3) open billing-adjustment case to review overcharged tokens, 4) communicate interim status to Acme. Agree?

accounts-bot: Created billing ticket BIL-8432 (priority high) assigned to accounts-team.

oliver: pls include estimated refunded token count and an ETA for customer message. customer wants a human comms ASAP.

jess: root cause hypothesis: a cache invalidation bug + gateway retry storm caused duplicate token accounting across retries. long-term fix: dedupe token accounting by request-id at meter ingestion and add idempotency key for prefix expansion results. I'll open a PR for the runtime patch and a follow-up eval.

mike: I'm going to hand this off to sara for the next oncall window. Handing notes: mitigation active, shared pool routing in effect, billing pause requested, BIL-8432 created, patches in-progress.

sara: taking over. noted mitigations. will monitor metric windows and coordinate with billing and cs for the customer update.

oliver: I'll draft a short message for Acme — will wait for token refund estimate from accounts.

mike: one more ops note — please don't auto-resume the async retry path until PR lands; re-enabling without dedupe will re-trigger.

jess: will add feature-flag gated rollout for the retry path and add unit tests for token dedupe logic.

accounts-bot: BIL-8432 updated: preliminary refund estimate 1,197,600 tokens (provisional). assigned to @accounts-team.

oliver: final for now — customer comms go out in 30m with apology + provisional refund + postmortem ETA 48h. thanks all. :thumbsup:
